title: Accessibility statement
description: The Battle for Middle-earth website aims to comply with WCAG 2.1 AA. What we have done, where the limits are, and how to report a problem.
subtitle: What we’ve done, where the boundaries are, and how to get in touch when something doesn’t work.
intro_p1_post: as the operator of www.panprstenu.cz commits to ensuring the accessibility of its websites in accordance with Czech Act No. 99/2019 Coll. on the accessibility of websites and mobile applications, which implements Directive (EU) 2016/2102 of the European Parliament and of the Council.
intro_p2: This accessibility statement applies to www.panprstenu.cz and all its subpages.
compliance_p: The website aims to comply with WCAG 2.1 level AA and takes into account the recommendations of EN 301 549. Some content may, in certain contexts, require minor adjustments — we address these continuously.
compliance_l1: Skip-to-content link to the main content (Tab from URL).
compliance_l2: Semantic HTML structure with landmarks (header, nav, main, footer).
compliance_l3: Keyboard operability of all interactive elements (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Esc).
compliance_l4: Visible focus ring in a prominent gold colour.
compliance_l5: Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for normal text, ≥ 3:1 for large text.
compliance_l6: Rules and organisational accordions use native <details> — they work without JavaScript and with screen readers.
compliance_l7_intro: Floating accessibility panel (bottom right) — the user can:
compliance_l7_c: switch to a sans-serif font (suitable for dyslexia),
compliance_l8: Respect for system preferences prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-color-scheme.
compliance_l9: Meaningful image text and alternative descriptions where needed.
compliance_l10: Hreflang for 5 language versions (cs, en, de, sk, uk).
compliance_l12: Style consistency and support for 100% browser zoom (Ctrl/Cmd +).
lim_p: Some parts of the website may, in individual cases, show minor deviations from WCAG 2.1 AA. Specifically:
lim_l1_pre: The embedded Google Maps in the section
lim_l1_post: is a third party and its accessibility is managed by Google. The event location is also given separately as plain text (GPS coordinates + link).
lim_l2: Decorative images (corner ornaments, wax seals, dividers) have aria-hidden="true" — they are hidden from screen readers so as not to clutter the listening experience.
lim_l3: The photo gallery from past editions does not yet have automatic alternative text for every shot — this will be added by the MVP launch.
prep_p1: This statement was prepared on 30 April 2026 based on a self-assessment carried out directly by the operator (tested by keyboard, screen reader, automated tools and manual contrast checks).
prep_p2: The statement was last reviewed on 30 April 2026.
report_h: Reporting accessibility issues and alternative content
report_p: If you have come across content or a feature that cannot be used well with a screen reader, keyboard or other assistive tool, write us. We will try to fix it and, in the meantime, provide the content in another, accessible form.
contact_response: We will respond within 30 days at the latest, in line with § 9 of Czech Act No. 99/2019 Coll.
enf_p_pre: If you have contacted us and have not received a satisfactory response, you can file a complaint with the supervisory body, which is the
enf_p_strong: Ministry of the Interior of the Czech Republic
